en.why: Blur reads as not yet in focus. A word at 52px blur still has its colour and rough width, so the eye sees where the text will land and then reads the meaning one word at a time at the pace of the stagger. The hero lines resolve letter by letter, so a word grows from the inside letter by letter; the smaller lines resolve per word, which keeps them quick. The blur-out is the same move in reverse, word by word, so a line leaves in the order it came and the next line arrives in the space it freed. The product screen behind starts blurred too and sharpens from 9px blur with the line We bring it into focus., so the image and the words say the same thing. The close is the only hold in the film: the tagline sharpens last, the screen dims to 13% and the mark lands under it, so the final frame is a tagline and a mark on near black with one amber accent, #ffb15c.
spec: Timing

Film 10.5s. Line 1 resolves 0.45–2.6s (0.28s between words, 0.035s between letters, 1.1s per letter) and blurs out 2.95–3.95s (0.1s between words); line 2 resolves 3.55–4.9s (0.2s between words, 0.95s each) and blurs out 5.15–6.05s; line 3 resolves 5.7–7.28s (0.17s between words, 0.9s each) and blurs out 7.0–8.02s (0.08s between words); tagline letters resolve 7.55–9.28s (0.3s between words, 0.04s between letters, 1.15s per letter); the tagline rises and the mark lands 8.7–9.65s; wordmark letters 8.85–10.11s; held to the end
Easing

Entrance blur, scale and drift power3.out, opacity power1.out over half the duration; exit blur, scale and drift power2.in, opacity power1.in starting 0.12s later; tagline rise, mark and wordmark cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) (expo.out); background screen sharpening and dimming power2.inOut; the pushes, the screen scale and the page scroll are constant-speed
Camera

Locked framing with slow drifts only: the text layer scales 1.0→1.045 over 0–10.5s; the editor behind scales 1.07→1.0 over 0–8s while its page scrolls up 140px; the lockup layer scales 1.0→1.035 over 8.7–10.5s
Subject

Inter 700, letter-spacing -0.035em, line height 1.04: lines 1 and 3 at 150px in two rows, line 2 at 168px in one row, tagline at 184px in one row. Each unit starts at 52px blur (tagline 60px), scale 1.12, opacity 0, drifts at most 9px sideways and rises from 12–26px below, and ends at 0px blur, scale 1; the exit goes to 46px blur, scale 1.07, 14px up, at most 7px sideways and opacity 0, with the drift taken from a seeded generator (mulberry32). Line 1 and the tagline split into letters; lines 2 and 3 move per word. The mark is a 108px amber rounded square (radius 24 per 100) with a dark C stroke and a cursor bar; the Clearline wordmark is Inter 700 at 96px, 26px from the mark. Behind it sits a 1700x960 Clearline editor at (110px, 60px) with a 250px sidebar, a draft titled Introducing Clearline 2.0 and a 360px clarity panel (score 92), at 60% opacity under an elliptical dark veil (1350x620, 80% at the centre, 12% at the edge)
Sync

While line 3 reads We bring it into focus., the editor sharpens from 9px blur over 5.6–6.9s; as the tagline resolves the editor dims from 60% to 13% over 7.5–8.6s and an amber glow behind the tagline rises over 7.55–8.95s; the tagline rises 104px at 8.7s and the mark starts resolving at 8.75s, so the lockup sits under the tagline; each line starts arriving 0.35–0.47s before the previous line has finished blurring out
Style

Near black #09090b, text #f4f4f6, grey #8a8a96 for blurry. and rough., one accent amber #ffb15c (clearly., the glow behind the tagline, the mark gradient #ffc98a to #ff8c38 and the suggestion marks in the editor); Inter only; a vignette (55% at the edge) and film grain (9% opacity, repositioned every 1/12s from a seeded generator)

says: Words come out of heavy blur one at a time
One line blurs away word by word and the next line comes in
The tagline sharpens last and the product mark lands under it
vs: Word-by-Word Highlight brightens words from gray to white in a line that never moves or blurs; in Blur Text Animation each word resolves from heavy blur with scale and drift, and the whole line then blurs away word by word.

One Word per Cut swaps words by cutting, with a new screen behind each one; in Blur Text Animation the words resolve in place from blur, lines hand over by blurring out, and the screen behind focuses once.

zh.why: 模糊在画面里读作还没对上焦。一个 52px 模糊的词仍有颜色和大致宽度，观众先看到文字会落在哪里，再随着变清楚一个词一个词读到意思，节奏由错开的间隔决定。主视觉行逐字变清楚，词从内部一点点长出来；较小的行按词变清楚，速度更快。虚化消失用同一个动作反向做，也是逐词，一行按进来的顺序离开，下一行在它让出的位置上进来。背后的产品界面一开始同样是虚的，到「We bring it into focus.」那一行时从 9px 模糊变清楚，画面和文字说的是同一件事。结尾是全片唯一的停顿：标语最后变清楚，界面压暗到 13%，标志落在标语下面，最后一帧是近黑底上的一句标语和一个标志，只有一个琥珀色强调色 #ffb15c。
spec: 时长

全片 10.5s。第 1 行 0.45–2.6s 变清楚（词间隔 0.28s，字间隔 0.035s，每个字 1.1s），2.95–3.95s 逐词虚化消失（词间隔 0.1s）；第 2 行 3.55–4.9s 变清楚（词间隔 0.2s，每个词 0.95s），5.15–6.05s 虚化消失；第 3 行 5.7–7.28s 变清楚（词间隔 0.17s，每个词 0.9s），7.0–8.02s 虚化消失（词间隔 0.08s）；标语 7.55–9.28s 逐字变清楚（词间隔 0.3s，字间隔 0.04s，每个字 1.15s）；8.7–9.65s 标语上移、标志落下；字标逐字 8.85–10.11s；保持到片尾
缓动
进场时模糊、缩放和位移用 power3.out，透明度用 power1.out，时长是进场的一半；出场时模糊、缩放和位移用 power2.in，透明度用 power1.in 并晚 0.12s 开始；标语上移、标志和字标 cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)（expo.out）；背景界面变清楚和压暗 power2.inOut；整体慢推、界面缩放和页面滚动匀速
镜头
构图固定，只有慢漂移：文字层 0–10.5s 从 1.0 倍推到 1.045 倍；背后的编辑器 0–8s 从 1.07 倍缩到 1.0 倍，页面同时向上滚 140px；落款层 8.7–10.5s 从 1.0 倍推到 1.035 倍
主体

Inter 700，字距 −0.035em，行高 1.04：第 1、3 行 150px 两排，第 2 行 168px 一排，标语 184px 一排。每个单元起始 52px 模糊（标语 60px）、缩放 1.12、透明度 0，侧向最多漂 9px、从下方 12–26px 处升起，结束于 0px 模糊、缩放 1；出场到 46px 模糊、缩放 1.07、上移 14px、侧向最多 7px、透明度 0，漂移量来自带种子的随机数（mulberry32）。第 1 行和标语按字拆开，第 2、3 行按词动。标志是 108px 的琥珀色圆角方块（圆角 24/100），里面是深色的 C 形描边和一条光标短杠；字标 Clearline 为 Inter 700、96px，和标志间距 26px。背后是 1700x960 的 Clearline 编辑器（左上角 110px、60px），含 250px 侧栏、标题 Introducing Clearline 2.0 的草稿和 360px 的清晰度面板（得分 92），透明度 60%，上面压一层椭圆形暗罩（1350x620，中心不透明度 80%，边缘 12%）
同步
第 3 行显示 We bring it into focus. 时，编辑器在 5.6–6.9s 从 9px 模糊变清楚；标语变清楚时编辑器在 7.5–8.6s 从 60% 压暗到 13%，标语背后的琥珀光在 7.55–8.95s 升起；标语 8.7s 上移 104px，标志 8.75s 开始变清楚，所以落款在标语下面；下一行在上一行还有 0.35–0.47s 才虚化完时就开始进场
风格
近黑 #09090b，文字 #f4f4f6，blurry. 和 rough. 用灰 #8a8a96，唯一强调色琥珀 #ffb15c（clearly.、标语背后的光、标志渐变 #ffc98a 到 #ff8c38、编辑器里的建议标记）；只用 Inter；暗角（边缘 55%）和胶片颗粒（不透明度 9%，每 1/12s 用种子随机数换一次位置）

en.title: Blur Text Animation: Example and Code Recipe
en.description: Words resolve from heavy blur one at a time, blur out, and a tagline sharpens into a product mark. Make it with Claude Code or Codex.
en.lede: Large words on a dark field resolve from heavy blur one at a time, each line blurs away word by word before the next arrives, the product screen behind sharpens with the line about focus, and the closing tagline sharpens before the product mark lands under it.
en.name: Blur Text Animation

body.h2: How to make a Blur Text Animation with Claude Code or Codex
body.body:
Give every word or letter the same entrance: start at 52px blur, scale 1.12 and opacity 0, with up to 9px of sideways drift and 12–26px below, then ease to 0px blur and scale 1 over 1.1s with power3.out while opacity rises over half that time with power1.out. Stagger the units: 0.28s between words and 0.035s between letters on the 150px hero line, 0.2s between words on the 168px second line. A line leaves by the reverse move word by word (46px blur, scale 1.07, 14px up, power2.in over 0.7s, 0.1s apart), and the next line starts arriving about 0.4s before it has finished.

Put a product screen behind the text and let it carry the idea. A 1700x960 editor sits at 60% opacity under a dark veil, starts at 9px blur and sharpens over 5.6–6.9s while the third line reads We bring it into focus. At 7.55s the 184px tagline Write clearly. resolves from 60px blur letter by letter (0.3s between words, 0.04s between letters), the screen dims to 13%, and at 8.7s the tagline rises 104px as a 108px mark and the wordmark resolve under it.

Press the copy button to send this recipe to Claude Code or Codex, or install the skill once with npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard. The agent builds the editor, the text units and the lockup. Use one accent such as amber #ffb15c on the last word of the tagline and the mark, keep Inter 700 with -0.035em letter-spacing, and take drift values from a seeded generator. Render an MP4 with HyperFrames, or port the GSAP timeline to your website.

en.alt: The headline "Write clearly." with an orange last word above the Clearline logo, over a dimmed app screen.
faq: What is a blur text animation?

A blur text animation shows text that starts heavily blurred and invisible and sharpens into focus, usually one word or letter at a time. A staggered start for each unit makes the line read in sequence, and the same blur applied in reverse makes a line leave.
How large should the blur be?

Large enough that a word loses its letter shapes but keeps its colour and width, which is about 46–60px of blur on 150–184px type. Add a small scale change (1.12 down to 1.0) and a few pixels of drift so the blur looks like focus pulling.
